and_yet: Sings road-songs while she counts, as her mother does.
sayings: Count it twice. Then once more.
family: Daughter of Taziri n'Khaleb; brothers Khalid and Davin; uncle Azghar.
name: Sarit n'Khaleb
appearance: 22, Imazuran, her mother's measuring-chain at her belt.
wants: To find out who is stopping the eastern trains.
does_not_want: Her mother to think she can't hold Orziben.
